description: A seller opens with a friendly note, then asks for a deposit through a payment link.

messages.text: Hello! You asked about the road bike on the marketplace. It is still available if you want it.
Great, can I come and see it this weekend?
Lots of people are asking, so I need a deposit to hold it. Pay the 50 GBP deposit here: https://pay.bike-deals.test/deposit/4471
Once you have paid, send me a screenshot and I will keep it for you until Saturday.
